title: Getting started with psnr
text: first time, psn_setup() creates Julia environment psnr installs Julia package (minutes). functions call automatically afterwards.

title: Getting started with psnr
text: network table ties, one row per tie. Names can numbers strings; converted character.
code: set.seed(1) g <- igraph::sample_smallworld(1, 100, 3, 0.2) igraph::V(g)$name <- paste0("p", seq_len(igraph::vcount(g))) edges <- igraph::as_data_frame(g, what = "edges") head(edges, 3) #>   from  to #> 1   p1  p2 #> 2   p3  p9 #> 3   p4 p76

title: Getting started with psnr

title: Getting started with psnr
text: desired one row per bin (real, counterfactual) dvals lists degrees . Consecutive degrees one element, like 1:2, merged single bin:
code: merged <- psn_sample(   edges,   desired = rbind(c(10, 10), c(5, 5), c(5, 5)),   dvals = list(1:2, 3, 4) ) unique(merged$bin) #> [1] "1:2" "3"   "4"

title: Getting started with psnr
text: consents named vector codes (0 = none, 1 = survey , 2 = survey photo, 3 = photo ), entry every node. Perceivers code 1 2 receive list, pairs limited people code 2 3.
code: codes <- setNames(sample(0:3, 100, replace = TRUE, prob = c(.1, .2, .5, .2)),                   igraph::V(g)$name) with_consent <- psn_sample(edges, consents = codes) length(unique(with_consent$perceiver)) #> [1] 68

title: Getting started with psnr
text: psn_inclusion_probs() returns exact probability, pi, pair perceiver’s list, design arguments. inverse weight estimation.
code: probs <- psn_inclusion_probs(edges) probs$weight <- 1 / probs$pi head(probs) #>   perceiver from  to bin real        pi   weight #> 1        p1 p100  p3   1 TRUE 1.0000000 1.000000 #> 2        p1   p3  p5   2 TRUE 0.2727273 3.666667 #> 3        p1   p3  p9   2 TRUE 0.2727273 3.666667 #> 4        p1   p4  p5   2 TRUE 0.2727273 3.666667 #> 5        p1   p4 p76   2 TRUE 0.2727273 3.666667 #> 6        p1   p4 p92   2 TRUE 0.2727273 3.666667

title: R Interface to SamplingPerceivedNetworks.jl
text: thin R interface SamplingPerceivedNetworks.jl, distance-based sampling procedure cognitive social structures data (Feltham, Forastiere & Christakis 2025, Nature Human Behaviour, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41562-025-02221-6). R side passes data Julia JuliaCall. logic lives Julia package; inst/julia/psn_shim.jl translates R data frames vectors arguments.

title: R Interface to SamplingPerceivedNetworks.jl
text: Requires Julia 1.10 later PATH, R package JuliaCall. psn_setup() creates Julia environment (tools::R_user_dir("psnr", "data")) installs SamplingPerceivedNetworks.jl dependencies first run, takes minutes. global Julia environment touched. use local copy Julia package instead GitHub version, run psn_setup(pkg = "path//SamplingPerceivedNetworks"). functions call psn_setup() later sessions.

title: R Interface to SamplingPerceivedNetworks.jl
text: See vignette("psnr") worked example (custom designs, consents, weights) ?psn_sample arguments. method (orbits, bins, carry-, consent rules) documented Julia package: https://human-nature-lab.github.io/SamplingPerceivedNetworks.jl.
code: library(psnr)  edges <- data.frame(from = as.character(1:20), to = as.character(c(2:20, 1)))  lists <- psn_sample(edges, seed = 1)   # lists of real and counterfactual pairs probs <- psn_inclusion_probs(edges)    # exact inclusion probabilities; weight = 1 / pi

title: Exact inclusion probabilities — psn_inclusion_probs
text: Computes, without random sampling, probability pair perceiver's list psn_sample(). Use 1 / pi estimation weight. Arguments psn_sample() (except seed shuffle, matter ). See inclusionprobs SamplingPerceivedNetworks.jl probability cover.

title: Exact inclusion probabilities — psn_inclusion_probs
code: psn_inclusion_probs(   edges,   nodes = NULL,   consents = NULL,   desired = NULL,   dvals = NULL,   carryover = TRUE )

title: Exact inclusion probabilities — psn_inclusion_probs
text: edges data frame matrix whose first two columns two endpoints tie (one row per tie). Values converted character. nodes Optional character vector node names. needed include isolates, appear row edges. consents Optional named integer vector consent codes, node names names: 0 = none, 1 = survey , 2 = survey photo, 3 = photo . Every node needs entry. perceivers code 1 2 receive list, pair eligible nodes code 2 3. desired Optional numeric matrix one row per degree bin two columns: number real counterfactual pairs draw. dvals Optional list one element per row desired, giving degree(s) bin: single number, vector consecutive degrees (e.g. 1:2) merge several distances one bin. Give desired dvals together, neither; neither, deployed design used (degrees 1 4, five real five counterfactual pairs ). carryover Whether bin falls short made bins.

title: Exact inclusion probabilities — psn_inclusion_probs
text: data frame one row every pair shown perceiver: perceiver, , , bin, real (psn_sample()) pi, probability pair perceiver's list. Pairs outside orbit, bin beyond dvals, listed (probability zero).

title: Sampling lists for every perceiver — psn_sample
text: edges data frame matrix whose first two columns two endpoints tie (one row per tie). Values converted character. nodes Optional character vector node names. needed include isolates, appear row edges. consents Optional named integer vector consent codes, node names names: 0 = none, 1 = survey , 2 = survey photo, 3 = photo . Every node needs entry. perceivers code 1 2 receive list, pair eligible nodes code 2 3. desired Optional numeric matrix one row per degree bin two columns: number real counterfactual pairs draw. dvals Optional list one element per row desired, giving degree(s) bin: single number, vector consecutive degrees (e.g. 1:2) merge several distances one bin. Give desired dvals together, neither; neither, deployed design used (degrees 1 4, five real five counterfactual pairs ). seed Integer seed Julia random number generator. default drawn R's generator, set.seed() makes results reproducible. shuffle Whether shuffle perceiver's list (otherwise sorted). carryover Whether bin falls short made bins.

title: Sampling lists for every perceiver — psn_sample
text: data frame one row per perceiver pair: perceiver, , (pair sorted alphanumerically), bin (degree bin, e.g. "1:2" "3", string) real (whether pair tie).

title: Start Julia and load the package — psn_setup
text: Starts Julia JuliaCall environment loads shim translates R data arguments SamplingPerceivedNetworks.jl. environment created first run (installs Julia package dependencies, takes minutes) reused afterwards. runs per R session; psn_sample() psn_inclusion_probs() call automatically.

text: environment lives per-user directory, tools::R_user_dir("psnr", "data"); set options(psnr.julia_env = "<dir>") first call use another. separate global Julia environment, nothing needs change. Julia 1.10 later must PATH. Julia can started per R session, set option call starts Julia.
